about: Words of a plot wish or a change request, English and German. Text that holds one as a whole word is never a pair list (routeInput rule 13) nor short data (rule 14): x bis 2030, y max 60, Titel 2026 are requests about the plot, not label/value pairs. words match in any case; lowercase_only match only as written, since Max and Min with a capital are first names. The server's pair-list reader holds the same lists (agents/anyplot/data/layouts.py, WISH_WORDS and LOWERCASE_WISH_WORDS), and tests/unit/agents/data/test_layouts.py pins them to this file. Labels that are an axis letter alone (x, y, z) are refused by both readers too.
